text:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: CACHE_SRV high error rate on kv-01 cluster. Alerting oncall (elaine) and sre team. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cache-surge

elaine: saw the page. I'm joining. currently ~12% 5xx from kv-01, latency up for small seq requests. Customers hit: heavy streaming/short completion workloads.

ryan: copying in runtime. Maria, any recent deploys to cache tier?

maria: no deploys last hour. We saw a spike in hot-prefix reads starting 3612345600. Likely a workload causing prefetch storms + eviction churn.

sam: CS reporting two enterprise customers saw elevated latencies and 429 for a few calls. Not widespread but a few tenants hit hard. CS wants ETA and mitigation.

elaine: immediate plan: 1) apply backpressure on tenant-level QPS for affected prefixed reads 2) disable aggressive prefetch for kv-01 cluster 3) enable safe-mode cache bypass for correctness if needed. Anyone object?

ryan: +1. For (1) we can push a short-lived quota carveout: scale down tenant QPS to 20% for hot tenants and redirect others to fallback. I'll run the traffic-sculpt command.

ops: running quota change for tenant tags: hot-tenant-A,hot-tenant-B. Command:
```
internalctl quota adjust --cluster kv-01 --tag hot-tenant-A --qps 20
internalctl quota adjust --cluster kv-01 --tag hot-tenant-B --qps 20
```
ETA: 30s to propagate.

maria: starting prefetch disable on kv-01 nodes:
```
/kube exec -n inference svc/cache-controller -- patch config --set prefetch.enabled=false --cluster=kv-01
```
I'll roll across zones 1 by 1 to avoid cascade.

inc-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0486. Severity: P1. Paging schedule updated. Oncall: elaine -> handoff to ryan in 20m if stable.

elaine: after quotas + prefetch disable: error rate dropped to ~3%, tail latency improving. CS: please confirm customer impact reduced.

cs-team: confirmed with hot-tenant-A contact: 429s stopped after ~45s; they saw some degraded throughput but acceptable. They've accepted workaround.

ryan: next step: evaluate correctness risk. Some keys show stale reads when we bypass cache. If we enable bypass for correctness we must ensure write-through reads to origin for those prefixes. Suggest enabling a targeted cache-bypass flag for prefixes where correctness failures observed.

maria: agree. We'll enable prefix-level bypass for the handful of incorrect prefixes. Command:
```
internalctl cache override --cluster kv-01 --prefix "user:session:hot-*" --mode bypass --reason correctness
```
Applying to 3 prefixes now.

sam: CS noted one customer had a correctness concern (stale tokens). With bypass enabled, they confirm fresher reads. They're okay with the temporary bypass.

elaine: I'm going to put a traffic-shaping policy to smooth incoming bursts to kv-01 globally for next 30m:
```
trafficctl shape --cluster kv-01 --policy burst-smoothing-30m --max-burst-pps 2000 --gradual-allow 10%/min
```
This should reduce headroom spike and give autoscaler time to ramp.

ops: shape policy active. Observing inbound QPS drop ~40% and node CPU stabilizing.

ryan: also increased eviction headroom: set eviction_threshold to 0.85 on kv-01 to avoid cascading evictions during warmups.

maria: note: we disabled prefetch; when we re-enable, use conservative prefetch window and cap async fetch concurrency. I'll prepare a safer config.

elaine: handoff plan: I'll stay on until metrics show 15m stability. If stable, hand off to ryan for monitoring and postmortem. Please collect timelines and customer-impact notes.

inc-bot: oncall handoff scheduled: elaine -> ryan at 3612346780 if not escalated.

cs-team: compiling impact report: customers affected: hot-tenant-A, hot-tenant-B, gamma-startup. Primary impact: 429s and elevated tail latency. Mitigation: quota carving, prefetch disable, prefix bypass. Current status: degraded -> stabilizing.

sam: flagging that Dedicated customers may want a post-incident follow-up about SLA blips. I'll draft comms after postmortem.

ryan: moving to watch mode. We'll plan a targeted canary for re-enabling prefetch with reduced concurrency tomorrow. Maria, leave the prefix-bypass active for 2 hours, then evaluate.

maria: prefix bypass set with TTL 2h. Logging enabled for bypassed reads to validate correctness.

elaine: thanks team. I'll open the postmortem ticket and add timeline + mitigation commands. Key items for followup: better hot-prefix detection, prefetch circuit-breaker, and tenant-level soft-qps dampening.

ops: noted for runbook updates. Adding step: "when prefetch spikes detected, immediately apply tenant QPS carveout before disabling prefetch" to avoid origin overload.

inc-bot: Incident INC-2026-0486 status: Mitigated -> Stable. Please acknowledge when you have added notes. :white_check_mark:

ryan: acked. Closing watch but keeping monitors at high sensitivity for 2 hours.

elaine: signing off to sleep after quick handoff. Good job. :thumbsup:
